answer: The orchard counter is kept in ivory and anchor exposes each reset. A bond is refunded only after 42 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A hostile operator therefore has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 42 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. That bill is paid per identity, so 97 aliases cost 207 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
